Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which 
performed on an annually bases or 
at any troubles accrues 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The function of Mazout (screw pump) 
fuel oil unloading pump:
transferring Mazout from pipes to storage tanks.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Emad El 
din Ali Elbana, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by EDEPC inspection & 
quality control eng. Samir Abd El- Gelil, approved by general manager eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif, 
 and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa El-Lethy: EDEPC inspection 
& quality control head sector.

Trouble Shooting
Trouble | Possible Reasons | Remedy
1. Loss of Flow | System component malfunction | Inspect all system components and 
 correct malfunction make sure all valve are in their proper position and suction and discharge line are open
 | Incorrect pump rotation | Shut down immediately. 
 Imo Pump are unidirectional and extended reverse rotation can cause damage. 
 Reveres the direction of the driver
 | Loss of prime or boost pressure | Shut down the pump 
 repine the pump and restart repeat until pump primes. 
 Check boost system for malfunction
 | Air leak in suction | Symptoms are form in the fluid and noise. Reseal and tighten all joints in suction line
 | Low oil level in reservoir | May be accompanied by noise and air in the fluid fill reservoir to proper level be sure intake is for enough below the minimum fluid level to prevent vortex
 | In sufficient inlet | May be accompanied by noise 
 may be caused by high fluid viscosity on cold start. Check suction line for blockage, closed valve or foot valve, clogged strainer. Check for plugged breather in tank
 | Mechanical trouble | Loss coupling, broken 
 shaft, failed pump, may be accompanied by noise or vibration locate and correct cause
2. Noisy or vibration Pump | Insufficient inlet pressure | May be pump speed excessive
Air in fluid | Check for leak in suction line low fluid level vortex at inlet to suction line, or return lines above fluid level
Pump not aligned | Realign the pump. Misalignment 
 may also be caused be temperature variation
Mechanical problems | Loose or mis-positioned coupling broken shaft, bad bearing
3. Excessive Power 
 Consumption | Pump speed excessive | Reduce pump rotational speed
High fluid viscosity | Reduce viscosity by temperature control of fluid
High pressure | Checks for blockage of 
 discharge line from the pump
Mechanical | Bent shaft, tight pacing pipe strain, failed pump locate and correct cause
Operation of the Pump
Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.
Ensure that the pump is OK and record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.
